name: Scheduler Tools
description: Lets an in-chat agent list and create scheduled tasks, and — with your approval each time — delete or run one. Every action follows the scheduler's "Allow agents to manage scheduled tasks" switch and permission policy. Also ships a Schedule digest Bot.
author: cognia-next
